narrative:
Fairfield County has 112,068 registered voters, with 54.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 28.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 17.1%, a clear Republican lean of 11.7 percentage points. Gen X are the largest generational cohort at 26.4% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -2.7% D−R vs -20.4% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
